publication: Spark file commit protocol; _SUCCESS marks completed dataset; readers before completion make only per-file claims
consistency: HDFS namespace and immutable completed files; no multi-writer or transaction isolation claim
retry: Native task retries; whole-application restart Never; errorifexists prevents blind replay over existing output

faults.executor: force delete one observed active executor Pod
faults.disk: fence one DataNode, prove two surviving full copies, replace only its PVC and verify restored three-copy hashes

limitations: All kind workers share one Docker VM
No HA, independent restore or physical power-loss qualification
